newsitem.title: USA: Union Carbide Q1 Basic Chemicals profit up.
newsitem.headline: Union Carbide Q1 Basic Chemicals profit up.

text.p: Union Carbide Corp said Monday its Basic Chemicals & Polymers segment reported first quarter operating profit of $62 million, up from $17 million in the 1996 fourth quarter and $58 million in the 1996 first quarter.
Union Carbide said the segment benefited from improved volumes and pricing for ethylene oxide and glycol, and from lower feedstock costs.

The company said its Specialties & Intermediates segment posted operating profit of $184 million for the first quarter, up from $157 million in the 1996 fourth quarter but down from $193 million in the 1996 first quarter.
